events.title_original: Why the genocide verdict against Myanmar has big implications for Israel | Geoffrey Robertson
events.summary: Proving the ‘crime of crimes’ against an individual is notoriously difficult, but the ICJ has set a precedent for states to be found liable. Israel could be next  For the first time ever, a state has been found  guilty of genocide  – that “crime of crimes” – and has been ordered to compensate victims and to prosecute and punish the perpetrators.
